title: State Machine Validator
summary: Validates every incoming state transition event against the applicable state machine definition, enforcing guards, actor-role requirements, and terminal-state immutability before persisting the transition.

inputs.name: state_machines
inputs.description: Active machine definitions keyed by machine_id

outputs.name: state-validation-errors
outputs.description: Rejected transition payloads with reason codes

obligations.summary: Every transition guard predicate MUST be evaluated; rejection reason MUST be persisted.
No outbound transition from a terminal state is permissible; attempt MUST be logged as security event.
